name: iCount Payment Gateway
author: iCount

sections.description:
The iCount Payment Gateway allows users to connect their WooCommerce website to iCount accounting platform.
This plugin facilitates two main objectives:
1. Accept credit card payments through iCount’s payment gateway.
2. Create invoices and receipts for each payment.
Use of this plugin is subject to accepting iCount Terms Of Use

External Services and Data Privacy

This plugin communicates with iCount’s internal API (https://api.icount.co.il) to process payments and manage invoices.
No third-party services other than iCount’s internal systems are used to handle data or transactions.

API and Data Usage:

  • The plugin uses the iCount API to transmit transaction data for payment processing and invoicing.
  • All data is transmitted securely between your website and iCount’s servers.
  • No data is sent to external services beyond the iCount system.

Please refer to iCount’s Terms of Use and Privacy Policy for more information on how your data is handled.

Features

  • Credit Card Payments: Seamless integration with iCount’s CC gateway to accept credit card payments securely.
  • Automated Invoicing: Automatically create invoices and receipts for each payment processed through the plugin.
  • Easy Setup: Simple configuration and setup process within your WooCommerce store.
  • Transaction Management: View and manage all transactions from your WooCommerce admin panel.

Configuration

  1. Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments.
  2. Click on iCount Payments.
  3. Enter your iCount API Token.
  4. Save changes.

Usage

  • Once configured, the plugin will enable credit card payments through iCount’s CC gateway.
  • Invoices and receipts will be automatically generated for each payment and can be viewed in your iCount account.

Support

If you have any questions or need assistance, please open a chat window from your iCount account:
https://app.icount.co.il/support/new_ticket.php

sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin from the repository or upload the icount-payment-gateway.zip file through the WordPress admin panel.
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New and click on Upload Plugin.
  3. Choose the icount-payment-gateway.zip file and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
